items.description:
The big platforms profile you from everything you read, watch and like, and their feeds are built to keep you there. Federated networks let you choose your server and still reach everyone, and alternative frontends let you read the big sites without an account or their tracking.
[!NOTE] The fediverseThe fediverse is a network of independent servers and apps that talk to each other over the open ActivityPub protocol. You can follow people on any of them from whichever one you join, and move elsewhere if you're unhappy. 🌎 This video by Framasoft explains the idea.Apps that speak ActivityPub carry the badge.
[!NOTE] Alternative frontends and clientsFrontends let you read these services without an account, ads or their scripts. The service still sees requests for the content you view, and only frontends that route everything through their own server hide your IP address from it. Public instances get blocked often, so expect to switch instances or self-host.These tools redirect links to alternative frontends automatically: 4110⭐ 150🍴 LibRedirect): browser extension that sends YouTube, Reddit, X and other links to alternative frontends.🌎 UntrackMe: Android app that rewrites YouTube, Twitter and other links to their open source alternatives.
